aws_backup_cross_region_copy.summary: Configure an approved cross-Region copy destination for each backup rule in this plan.
steps: Inspect the named backup plan and every rule's configured CopyActions and destination vault ARN; identify the rules without a proven destination in another Region.
Review destination Region, vault ownership, encryption, resource support, retention, data residency, and added copy cost with the recovery owner.
Add an approved cross-Region copy action to each affected rule under change control, then read back the plan and verify actual copy-job outcomes separately.
caveats: This check verifies declared copy actions only. It does not prove backup job execution, completed copies, retention, or successful restore.
Cross-Region copy availability and encryption behavior vary by resource and Region; validate the workload before changing the plan.
A missing caller partition, malformed or unreadable destination vault ARN, or malformed empty rule list remains UNKNOWN unless another valid rule has a definite missing cross-Region action.
